messages:
maria (AE): Quick thread 1 Crestline wants a scoped POC for identity flows next week. Must-haves: signed+encrypted SAML with Okta, SCIM provisioning + robust deprovisioning (compliance wants proof of irrevocable removal), RBAC mapping from groups + attribute-based rules, domain isolation per-tenant, and a short procurement note on hosted vs dedicated. They also asked whether we support SCIM token rotation hooks (webhook on rotation).

tom (SE): @maria we support SAML2.0 with both signed and encrypted assertions. Metadata upload and SP-initiated + IdP-initiated supported. We can map incoming SAML attributes to our internal subject_id and a roles claim. For encrypted assertions we accept XML-enc with RSA keys.

tom (SE): SCIM: RFC7644. We support PATCH, PUT, POST, DELETE. By default DELETE -> soft-delete retention 45 days (compliance default), with hard-delete via admin API + justification header for auditable workflow. We record deletion events in audit logs and produce a deletion certificate (signed) on-demand for compliance teams.

nadia (Solutions): Important: Crestline requires proof of permanent data removal for ex-employees (regulatory). We can provide an export showing deletion event and final hard-delete timestamp if they trigger hard-delete. On Dedicated we can shorten soft-delete TTL to immediate hard-delete if requested with correct config + DPA change.

leo (Security): A few asks from their security questionnaire: 1) Can we send a webhook when SCIM tokens rotate? 2) Where are SCIM tokens stored and how are they protected? 3) What is our default audit log retention and who can access logs?

tom (SE): Answers: 1) We emit events to customer webhook endpoints for provisioning lifecycle (created/updated/deleted) and can add a token-rotation event hook for Dedicated/Private. For hosted eval we can set up a short-lived manual webhook.

tom (SE): 2) SCIM tokens are encrypted with KMS at rest. On Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP CMEK). We recommend rotating tokens every 30 days; our admin API supports immediate revocation.

tom (SE): 3) Audit logs default retention 90 days. Access controlled by RBAC; only admin+security roles can export. Extended retention to 1 year available as add-on. Exports redact PII unless admin explicitly requests full export under an audit workflow.

nadia (Solutions): Procurement blurb draft: "Hosted eval: fastest path to test SSO + SCIM functionality with minimal lead time; logical tenant isolation, default audit retention, limited CMK options; pay-as-you-go pricing (metered). Dedicated: dedicated compute and networking, full CMK support, configurable retention and rate limits, SLA-backed availability; priced on committed capacity (typical entry $22k+/mo depending on throughput)."

leo (Security): Add that Dedicated includes SOC2 AOC under NDA and the ability to run vulnerability scans in a pre-prod window.

maria (AE): Crestline also asked about domain proofing: they want to use delegated subdomains (customer.company.redwood.example) and need automatic cert issuance. How's cert management handled?

tom (SE): We support DNS TXT validation for domain binding. For delegated subdomains we can provision TLS certs via ACME (Let's Encrypt or customer ACME endpoint) when using Dedicated or Private with routing controls. Hosted supports managed certs for verified domains. We keep cert private keys encrypted; we also support bringing your own certs in Dedicated.

nadia (Solutions): They want strong RBAC: multiple group-to-role mappings, precedence rules, and attribute-based grants (e.g., jobTitle contains "manager" -> elevated read access). We have policy engine that supports boolean rules and group precedence. Will prepare a sample policy file.

maria (AE): They also need a small sample SCIM curl showing delete + If-Match + X-Hard-Delete header for compliance. Can we paste a minimal example?

tom (SE): Sample (hard-delete request):

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/9a7b" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "If-Match: \"a1b2c3d4\"" \
  -H "X-Hard-Delete: true" \
  -H "X-Deletion-Justification: \"Regulatory removal request CREST-2026-01\""
```

Response will include a deletion_certificate_url you can fetch later.

infra-bot: Provisioned POC namespace 'crestline-poc-0502' (eu-central-1). Temporary SCIM token and SAML metadata uploaded to maria via DM.

leo (Security): Note for questionnaire: TLS minimum 1.2, recommend 1.3; encryption at rest AES-256; KMS integration for customer-managed keys; we redact PII in logs by default. Will attach answers to the doc.

maria (AE): Schedule kickoff: Thurs 11am CET. Requesting Crestline upload IdP metadata and a CSV of 5k sample users for initial seed. Also ask for list of groups + attributes they want mapped.

nadia (Solutions): I'll prepare a policy sample and a short checklist for pre-seed CSV (columns, max batch size).

maria (AE): Thanks team 1 I'll send invite and attach procurement blurb + sample SCIM examples. Will update here after kickoff with any blockers.
